programme.title: Chaand Aur Sooraj
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar tells that today we know so much more about nature to the extent that we have cut off an emotional attachment with it. Do you remember the last time you peaked out of your windows or went on your roof tops to see the moon?

programme.title: Ghum
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Ghum, the feeling of sadness in shayaris And how people relate to it in different ways. He says you should share your sadness/sorrows just as you would share your happiness as this will help you deal with it better.

programme.title: Duniya
programme.desc: Duniya

programme.title: Yaad
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says when you are in love And there is a distance involved, it is only those moments with your loved ones in your memory that keep you going. Once a memory either good or bad is fixed in your mind it remains there forever.

programme.title: Waqt: The Race Against Time
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says time is a sea that holds us all. No matter how powerful we may become we will always be helpless in front of time. Time once passed cannot be brought back therefore we should make the most of it by doing good things.

programme.title: Aawargi
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar tells us that in Urdu shayaris aawara does not mean a loafer whose standing on roads whistling but the one who ditches the old ways And is always ready to find new ones, unaware of where the new path will lead him.

programme.title: Barbaad
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says love makes us do passionate things And we end up breaking the societal norms, beliefs And principles which make people believe that we are ruined. He says when you are ruined in love it becomes an example of your level of love.

programme.title: Intezaar
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says you either wait for the one you love or you wait for some worldly affairs with a hope for a better tomorrow.

programme.title: Ummeed Aarzu
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about hope of finishing a work, hope of meeting someone, hope of achieving dreams. He says you will lose the day you stop hoping And trying.

programme.title: Mohabbat
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar explains the difference between Mohabbat And Ishq And the difficulties arising in loving someone. Love is when youre thoughtful of the other persons likes And wants.

programme.title: Wafa
programme.desc: Javed Aktar tells how poets have always given priority to loyalty than love in their writings. Loyalty is the most important thing in every relationship.

programme.title: Dil
programme.desc: Javed Aktar says the hero of any Urdu shayari is neither lover nor beauty not even love, it is always the heart. He says in different situations the heart responds differently.

programme.title: Deewana
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar says some people are in love with either their work or a person or some motive or a goal. Sometimes passion in your love is necessary to be able to achieve what you want.

programme.title: Judaayi
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar tells how love makes us feel pleasant And rejuvinated but when our loved one leaves us everything becomes dull. He says sometimes separation can make us grow stronger in life if dealt with correctly.

programme.title: Sukoon
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the search of Peace and the range in which human beings search for it by trying to gain money or indulging in addiction of drinking etc. which all lead to temporary happiness.
